sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们获得了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的大学，致力于解决当今世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境领域最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内合作创新，寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学旨在提升所有生物生活质量的使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stcentury.ucdavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 请访问 21stcentury.ucdavis.edu 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Morris.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·莫里斯。

sentences.en: It can hardly be a coincidence that no language on earth has ever produced the expression as pretty as an airport.
sentences.zh: 地球上没有任何一种语言能创造出“如机场般美丽”这样的表达，这绝非巧合。

sentences.en: Airports are ugly, some very ugly.
sentences.zh: 机场很难看，有些甚至非常难看。

sentences.en: Some attain a degree of ugliness that can only be the result of a special effort.
sentences.zh: 有些机场丑得达到了某种程度，那绝对是特意努力的结果。

sentences.en: This ugliness arises because airports are full of people who are tired, cross, and have just discovered that their luggage has landed in Murmansk.
sentences.zh: 这种丑陋之所以产生，是因为机场里到处都是疲惫、烦躁、且刚发现自己的行李飞到了摩尔曼斯克的人。

sentences.en: Murmansk Airport is the only exception of this otherwise infallible rule.
sentences.zh: 摩尔曼斯克机场是这条原本百试百灵的规则唯一的例外。

sentences.en: And architects have, on the whole, tried to reflect this in their designs.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，建筑师们一直在努力在设计中反映这一点。

sentences.en: From Douglas Adams, the long, dark tea time of the soul.
sentences.zh: 摘自道格拉斯·亚当斯的《灵魂的长黑暗茶时》。

sentences.en: I think so many airports were not designed for the things that they have to do right now.
sentences.zh: 我认为很多机场在设计之初，并不是为了应对它们现在必须承担的功能。

sentences.en: And so it is all fixing as you go.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都是边走边修。

sentences.en: There wasn't some great master plan.
sentences.zh: 并没有什么宏大的总规划。

sentences.en: So when it comes to the ugliness and general dysfunction of airports...
sentences.zh: 因此，说到机场的丑陋和普遍的功能失调……

sentences.en: They're a little bit off the hook.
sentences.zh: 它们多少算是有情可原。

sentences.en: A little bit off the hook, but there's plenty of room for improvement.
sentences.zh: 算是情有可原，但改进的空间依然很大。

sentences.en: When I spoke with Alison Arioff about the design of airports, she said to me,
sentences.zh: 当我与艾莉森·阿里奥夫谈论机场设计时，她对我说：

sentences.en: if all airports simply played Brian Eno's album Music for Airports over the speakers, every airport would be better.
sentences.zh: 如果所有机场只是通过扬声器播放布赖恩·伊诺的专辑《机场音乐》，那么每个机场都会变得更好。

sentences.en: My name is Alison Arioff, and I write about design and sustainability for the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我叫艾莉森·阿里奥夫，我为《纽约时报》撰写关于设计与可持续发展的文章。

sentences.en: I say this to serve not only as an introduction to Alison Arioff, but also so that you'll know that she is someone whose judgment is perfectly true.
sentences.zh: 我说这话不仅是为了介绍艾莉森·阿里奥夫，也是为了让大家知道，她是一个判断力绝对准确的人。

sentences.en: An architect I spoke to said nothing is more quickly obsolete than an airport building.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的一位建筑师说，没有什么比机场建筑过时得更快了。

sentences.en: Like, the technology is changing so faSt.
sentences.zh: 比如，科技变化太快了。

sentences.en: And the thing that all airports are still trying to catch up to now,
sentences.zh: 而所有机场至今仍在努力追赶的事物——

sentences.en: the thing that forced airports to change the most the fastest, was 9-11.
sentences.zh: 迫使机场变化最大也最快的事物，是“9·11”事件。

sentences.en: Security screening has come to dominate all aspects of airport design, but we're going to focus on just two effects.
sentences.zh: 安全检查已经主导了机场设计的方方面面，但我们将只关注其中两个影响。

sentences.en: The first is that because the unpredictability and time required to go through security,
sentences.zh: 第一个影响是，由于安检的不可预测性和所需时间，

sentences.en: you no longer dawdle on what is called the land side of the airport.
sentences.zh: 你不再在被称为机场“陆侧”的地方闲逛。

sentences.en: Land side is basically the curb appeal part of the airport.
sentences.zh: 陆侧基本上就是机场吸引眼球的部分。

sentences.en: Parking is still considered land side.
sentences.zh: 停车场仍然被视为陆侧。

sentences.en: The ticketing area is still considered land side.
sentences.zh: 售票区仍然被视为陆侧。

sentences.en: The wonderful lines that you have to wait in to TSA, which are also changing, by the way.
sentences.zh: 你必须排着长队等待安检的地方，顺便说一句，这些也在发生变化。

sentences.en: Most airports, of course, have had to make room for those lines, so all of that is land side.
sentences.zh: 当然，大多数机场都不得不为这些队伍腾出空间，所以这些都属于陆侧。

sentences.en: So once you wind yourself through the pleasant experience that is security, you are on the air side.
sentences.zh: 因此，一旦你蜿蜒穿过安检那令人愉快的体验，你就来到了空侧。

sentences.en: The people responsible for building airports really kind of followed the bus station model, where it was like a holding pen.
sentences.zh: 负责建造机场的人实际上有点遵循了汽车站的模式，它就像是一个候车围栏。

sentences.en: We just got you here as long as we need to put you on Amtrak or put you on Greyhound.
sentences.zh: 只要我们需要把你送上美铁或灰狗巴士，就把你弄到这里。

sentences.en: And airports were sort of on that model too, because the assumption was you were just passing through.
sentences.zh: 机场在某种程度上也遵循这种模式，因为当时的假设是你只是路过。

sentences.en: Now the assumption is that you are absolutely not just passing through.
sentences.zh: 现在的假设是，你绝对不仅仅是路过。

sentences.en: The assumption is that you are going to be staying a while.
sentences.zh: 现在的假设是你将逗留一段时间。

sentences.en: So newer airports are designed with that in mind.
sentences.zh: 因此，较新的机场在设计时就考虑到了这一点。

sentences.en: And a good example of this new thinking, described in a recent New York Times article by Arief,
sentences.zh: 这种新思维的一个很好的例子——正如阿里奥夫在《纽约时报》最近的一篇文章中所描述的——

sentences.en: is the new T2 terminal designed by Gensler Architects at San Francisco International Airport.
sentences.zh: 是由根斯勒建筑事务所为旧金山国际机场设计的全新T2航站楼。

sentences.en: T2 is the new terminal for American Airlines and Virgin America at San Francisco International Airport.
sentences.zh: T2是美国航空公司和维珍美国航空在旧金山国际机场的新航站楼。

sentences.en: And it's one of the first terminals to be designed post 9-11.
sentences.zh: 它是“9·11”之后首批设计的航站楼之一。

sentences.en: The last terminal constructed before T2 at SFO was the International Terminal that opened in December of 2000.
sentences.zh: 在T2之前，旧金山国际机场建造的最后一个航站楼是于2000年12月开业的国际航站楼。

sentences.en: It still feels pretty new, but you can tell right away that the trajectory of airport design
sentences.zh: 它现在看起来仍然很新，但你一眼就能看出，机场设计的轨迹

sentences.en: was going in a very different direction in the year 2000 than what is prioritized today.
sentences.zh: 在2000年时所走的方向，与当今的优先级截然不同。

sentences.en: San Francisco's main international terminal, for example, is all about the ticketing area.
sentences.zh: 例如，旧金山的主要国际航站楼完全围绕售票区展开。

sentences.en: You walk in, it's just this massive amount of space.
sentences.zh: 当你走进去，空间简直大得惊人。

sentences.en: It's open and airy and actually pretty wonderful to experience.
sentences.zh: 它开阔通透，体验其实相当不错。

sentences.en: But in the new world of TSA, all that building doesn't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 但在TSA（美国运输安全管理局）的新世界里，这么大的建筑毫无意义。

sentences.en: If you actually sit and think about it, you realize that all the exciting stuff is on the land side.
sentences.zh: 如果你坐下来仔细想想，你会发现所有令人兴奋的东西都在陆侧。

sentences.en: You're eating, you're shopping, etc.
sentences.zh: 你在吃东西、购物等等。

sentences.en: All that happens before security.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都发生在安检之前。

sentences.en: In the new T2, all the good stuff is saved post-security because, as we all know,
sentences.zh: 在全新的T2中，所有好东西都留在了安检之后，因为众所周知，

sentences.en: everyone's just rushing to their plane and they don't want to linger at all.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在急匆匆地赶飞机，根本不想逗留。

sentences.en: So while there is a very generous, well-designed ticketing area,
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然这里有一个非常宽敞、设计精良的售票区，

sentences.en: they've given way more square footage, like thousands and thousands of square feet,
sentences.zh: 但他们将更多的平方英尺——比如成千上万平方英尺的空间——

sentences.en: to what's called the air side, which is where the planes actually come into the gate.
sentences.zh: 让给了所谓的空侧，也就是飞机实际停靠登机口的地方。

sentences.en: What's also different about T2 is that they're really incorporating the security procedures
sentences.zh: T2的不同之处还在于，他们真正将安检程序

sentences.en: in the design from the get-go.
sentences.zh: 从一开始就融入到了设计之中。

sentences.en: So when you look at security now, it often looks like the TSA just set up shop yesterday
sentences.zh: 所以当你现在看安检时，它通常看起来像TSA昨天才刚刚搭好的店铺，

sentences.en: with retractable barriers and then it spits you out to a couple of folding chairs
sentences.zh: 有着可伸缩的护栏，然后把你吐到几把折叠椅上，

sentences.en: to put on your shoes and stow your laptop.
sentences.zh: 让你穿上鞋子、收好笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: The new T2 actually has what they call a recompose zone,
sentences.zh: 而新的T2实际上拥有他们所谓的“重组区”，

sentences.en: which is like a lounge for putting your clothes back on after you get through TSA
sentences.zh: 这就像是一个休息室，供你在通过TSA后重新穿好衣服，

sentences.en: with some sculpture and lots of natural light and skylights.
sentences.zh: 那里有雕塑、充足的自然光和天窗。

sentences.en: And once you are at that spot, putting your shoes and your belt and your jewelry and whatever else
sentences.zh: 一旦你到了那个地方，重新穿上鞋子、系上皮带、戴好首饰以及其他东西，

sentences.en: back on, you can see everything that you're about to enter into.
sentences.zh: 你就可以看到你即将进入的所有区域。

sentences.en: Retail, gates, seating, all that sort of stuff.
sentences.zh: 零售店、登机口、座位区，诸如此类。

sentences.en: I never give much thought to shops or restaurants and airports,
sentences.zh: 我以前从不怎么关注机场里的商店或餐厅，

sentences.en: but the thing I need, not want, what I need when I travel is a place to plug in my phone
sentences.zh: 但我旅行时需要（而不是想要）的是一个可以给我的手机或笔记本电脑充电的地方，

sentences.en: or a laptop and probably both.
sentences.zh: 可能两个都需要。

sentences.en: There are many, many more banks of outlets because, again, you think even back to pre-9-11,
sentences.zh: 这里有非常非常多的电源插座排，因为再想想，甚至在“9·11”之前——

sentences.en: which is now just about 10 years ago, the ubiquity of personal technology was not,
sentences.zh: 那大约是10年前——个人科技的普及率并没有……

sentences.en: you know, there were Walkmans, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那时候有随身听，对吧？

sentences.en: They didn't need to get plugged in.
sentences.zh: 它们不需要插电。

sentences.en: Now everyone's got something at every age, every sort of traveling segment.
sentences.zh: 现在，各个年龄段、各种旅行群体的每个人都有各种电子设备。

sentences.en: So, of course, older airports don't have enough.
sentences.zh: 所以，老旧机场当然不够用。

sentences.en: I was in O'Hare recently, sitting on the floor next to this businessman,
sentences.zh: 我最近在奥黑尔机场，坐在一个商人旁边的地板上，

sentences.en: and we were huddled like hobos around a single outlet in this three-gate area.
sentences.zh: 我们像流浪汉一样缩在这个只有三个登机口的区域里唯一的插座旁。

sentences.en: Pop, leveling 1-6,000.
sentences.zh: 波普，正在飞往16000英尺高度。

sentences.en: According to Area F, human factor studies shows that passengers want to stay within
sentences.zh: 根据阿里的说法，人类因素研究表明，乘客希望呆在

sentences.en: 250 feet of their gate, and T2 at SFO addresses this anxiety.
sentences.zh: 距离登机口250英尺以内的范围内，旧金山国际机场的T2很好地解决了这种焦虑。

sentences.en: If you're buying a paper, grabbing a coffee, sitting down at the restaurant,
sentences.zh: 无论你是在买报纸、买咖啡，还是坐在餐厅里，

sentences.en: all of the gates are visible all the time because of the open floor plan.
sentences.zh: 由于开放式的平面设计，所有登机口随时都清晰可见。

sentences.en: What I heard a lot in talking to many, many architects about airports is that
sentences.zh: 我在与众多建筑师交流关于机场的话题时听到最多的是，

sentences.en: at the top of the list is letting people feel in control of their experience
sentences.zh: 排在首位的是让人们感到自己能够掌控自己的体验，

sentences.en: and having a sense of where they're going and really sort of designing so that all of
sentences.zh: 对自己的去向有方向感，并且进行真正周到的设计，

sentences.en: the anxiety that comes naturally with that whole process now is alleviated to the greatest extent.
sentences.zh: 从而最大程度地缓解现在整个安检过程中自然产生的所有焦虑。

sentences.en: And so a good sort of environments designer who can really intuit where people's hang-ups
sentences.zh: 因此，一个优秀的环境设计师能够真正直观地感受到人们的痛点所在，

sentences.en: are going to be is key to a successful project.
sentences.zh: 这是项目成功的关键。

sentences.en: The noble goal is to try to design away all airport anxieties, no matter how experienced the traveler.
sentences.zh: 崇高的目标是试图通过设计消除所有机场焦虑，无论旅客经验多么丰富。

sentences.en: But who knows, in 10 years I could be redoing this story and contrasting T2 against some
sentences.zh: 但谁知道呢，10年后的我可能会重新制作这个故事，将T2与某个

sentences.en: new super airport that solves all the problems of usage that T2 failed to anticipate.
sentences.zh: 解决T2未能预见的使用问题的新超级机场进行对比。

sentences.en: There's no place to park my jetpack.
sentences.zh: 这里没有地方停放我的喷气背包。

sentences.en: Fail.
sentences.zh: 差评。

sentences.en: For anything complex, perfect design is a moving target.
sentences.zh: 对于任何复杂的事物来说，完美的设计都是一个不断移动的目标。

sentences.en: But odds are your luggage will still be in Murmansk.
sentences.zh: 但你的行李大概率还是在摩尔曼斯克。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by me, Roman Mars, with support from Lunar,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由我罗曼·马尔斯制作，并得到了致力于

sentences.en: making a difference with creativity.
sentences.zh: 用创意创造改变的Lunar公司的支持。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW, 91.7 Local Public Radio in San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 这是旧金山91.7本地公共广播电台KALW的一个项目，

sentences.en: the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 合作方包括美国建筑师学会旧金山分会

sentences.en: and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 以及建筑与设计中心。

sentences.en: You can keep up with Alison Arioff at the Opinionator blog of the New York Times,
sentences.zh: 你可以在《纽约时报》的“评论家”博客上关注艾莉森·阿里奥夫，

sentences.en: and I should mention that the Douglas Adams quote at the top of the show was read by Francesca
sentences.zh: 我还要提到，节目开头的道格拉斯·亚当斯名言是由弗朗西斯卡·潘内塔朗读的，

sentences.en: Panetta, who's the producer and creator of the Hackney podcast, which is consistently stunning
sentences.zh: 她是《哈克尼》播客的制作人和创作者，该播客一直都非常惊艳和精彩，

sentences.en: and amazing, and you should subscribe, although it does have a dearth of Francesca Panetta's
sentences.zh: 你应该去订阅，尽管里面其实有点缺乏弗朗西斯卡·潘内塔的声音。

sentences.en: voice in it.
sentences.zh: 你在这里听到的她的声音，可能比你在《哈克尼》播客中听到的还要多。

sentences.en: You've probably heard more of her here than you'll ever hear on the Hackney podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，弗兰。

sentences.en: Thank you, Fran.
sentences.zh: 想要了解更多信息并获取各种链接，请访问网站。

sentences.en: To find out more and get all kinds of links, go to the website.
sentences.zh: 网址是 99percentinvisible.org。

sentences.en: It's 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 这就是 99percentinvisible.org。
